# Rothenberg Law Firm

> > A 55+ year personal injury law firm serving clients across New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania with expertise in car accidents, medical malpractice, and wrongful death claims.

Rothenberg Law Firm is a multi-state personal injury practice with offices in major cities including New York City, Philadelphia, and New Jersey. The firm specializes in motor vehicle accidents, slip-and-fall cases, medical malpractice, and negligence claims, offering free consultations to prospective clients.
